steps.title: Prepare clearing solutions
steps.instruction: Make all solutions listed in the Recipes section using the exact concentrations, volumes, and storage conditions described.

substeps.instruction: Methanol/diH2O series (total 20 mL each): 20 % = 4 mL methanol + 16 mL water; 40 % = 8 mL methanol + 12 mL water; 60 % = 24 mL methanol + 8 mL water; 80 % = 16 mL methanol + 4 mL water. Prepare fresh the day of or day before and let reach room temperature (~1.5 h).
70 % ethanol: 700 mL absolute ethanol + 300 mL water = 1 L. Store sealed up to 1 year.
Peroxide‑methanol solution: 5 % H2O2 = 4 mL 30 % H2O2 + 80 % methanol = 20 mL → total 24 mL. Store sealed up to 1 year.
66 % DCM/33 % methanol: 16 mL dichloromethane + 8 mL methanol = 24 mL. Prepare within 24 h; use double nitrile gloves, work in hood, expel slowly; do not store long‑term.

Tert‑butanol series (total 24 mL each): 30 % = 7.2 mL tert‑butanol + 16.8 mL water; 50 % = 12 mL + 12 mL; 70 % = 16.8 mL + 7.2 mL; 80 % = 19.2 mL + 4.8 mL; 90 % = 21.6 mL + 2.4 mL; 96 % = 23.04 mL + 0.96 mL. Make within 24 h, bring to 37 °C (≈1.5 h) before use.
BABB (benzyl alcohol/benzyl benzoate): 33.33 % benzyl alcohol = 6 mL + 66.66 % benzyl benzoate = 12 mL → 18 mL total. Store sealed up to 1 year.
BABB‑D15: 93.38 % BABB = 15 mL + 6.22 % diphenyl ether = 1 mL + 0.4 % vitamin E = 0.064 mL → 16.064 mL total. Store sealed up to 1 year.
1× PBS: Dilute 50 mL 10× PBS with 450 mL deionized water → 500 mL. Add 0.1 % sodium azide if desired; store at 4 °C (optional).

steps.title: Prepare animal, reagents, and pump
steps.instruction: Weigh the rat, ready PBS, 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS, and the anesthetic cocktail; flush the peristaltic pump with PBS and eliminate bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the Long‑Evans rat (3–12 months, 290–597 g).
Prepare 1× PBS for system flushing.
Prepare 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS (fixative).
Prepare anesthetic cocktail: ketamine 80 mg kg⁻¹ and xylazine 10 mg kg⁻¹ (catalog numbers RXKETAMINE and RXXYLAZINE).
Flush the peristaltic pump with PBS until no bubbles are visible; continue flushing until a clear meniscus is seen at the tube end before switching to fixative.

steps.title: Perfuse animal with PBS then fixative
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the rat, perform a thoracic incision, insert a 15‑gauge needle into the left ventricle, and perfuse sequentially with PBS and then 4 % PFA.

substeps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with 3 % isoflurane in oxygen.
Make a mid‑abdominal incision, separate liver and diaphragm, cut ribs to expose the heart.
Insert a 15 G needle into the posterior left ventricle (snip skin if needed) and clamp if desired.
Snip the right atrium to allow outflow.
Perfuse PBS at room temperature until the liver loses color and the outflow is clear (~200 mL).
Switch to 4 % PFA fixative; continue perfusion for another ~200 mL (animal becomes stiff).

steps.title: Extract brain and fix overnight
steps.instruction: Decapitate, remove the skull, free the brain, and incubate it in fixative for 10–24 h.

substeps.instruction: Remove the head with scissors or a guillotine.
Trim muscles and cut an incision from neck to face to expose the skull.
Carefully remove the skull with rongeurs, avoiding chip fragments.
Sever cranial nerves with a spatula, blade, or small scissors to release the brain.
Place the brain in 15–20 mL of 4 % PFA (glass or polypropylene vial) and store 10–24 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash brain in PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the fixed brain three times with 1× PBS, 30 min each, rocking at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add 1× PBS to the vial, rock for 30 min at RT; repeat two more washes.
Optional: store the brain in PBS for ≤3 days at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dehydrate brain (uDISCO pathway)
steps.instruction: Sequentially transfer the brain through increasing concentrations of tert‑butanol, rocking at 37 °C overnight at each step.

substeps.instruction: Mix tert‑butanol solutions and let reach room temperature (~1.5 h).
30 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
50 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
70 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
80 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
90 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
96 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).
100 % tert‑butanol: rock at 37 °C overnight (10–24 h).

steps.title: Clear brain with DCM and BABB‑D15 (uDISCO)
steps.instruction: Replace tert‑butanol with DCM then BABB‑D15, observing safety precautions and periodic inversion.

substeps.instruction: Transfer brain to 100 % DCM; rock at room temperature for 2.5–3 h. Wear double nitrile gloves, work in a ventilation hood, and wipe the vial exterior with ≥70 % ethanol.
Move brain to fresh BABB‑D15; incubate ≥3 h, inverting the vial several times (ideally every 30 min, flexible 15–45 min).
Wipe the vial exterior again with ≥70 % ethanol.
Store cleared brains indefinitely at room temperature or 4 °C (4 °C recommended for long‑term storage).

steps.title: Dehydrate brain (iDISCO pathway)
steps.instruction: Pass the brain through a graded methanol series at room temperature, rocking as indicated.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh methanol solutions and let reach room temperature (~1.5 h).
20 % methanol in water: rock 3 h, then replace with fresh 20 % methanol and rock another 3 h.
40 % methanol in water: rock 2 h, then replace with fresh 40 % methanol and rock overnight.
60 % methanol in water: rock 3 h, then replace with fresh 60 % methanol and rock another 3 h.
80 % methanol in water: rock 2 h, then replace with fresh 80 % methanol and rock overnight.
100 % methanol: rock 3 h, then replace with fresh 100 % methanol and rock another 3 h. Brains can be stored at 4 °C in the dark for months.

steps.title: Bleach and wash brain (iDISCO)
steps.instruction: Bleach the brain in peroxide‑methanol, then wash repeatedly in 100 % methanol.

substeps.instruction: Incubate brain in 5 % H2O2 (in methanol) for 48–72 h at room temperature with rocking.
Wash three times in 100 % methanol, rocking 2 h per wash at room temperature.
Brains may be stored at 4 °C in the dark for months after the washes.

steps.title: Clear brain with DCM and DBE (iDISCO)
steps.instruction: Move the brain through DCM and finally into dibenzyl ether (DBE), observing safety steps and periodic inversion.

substeps.instruction: Transfer brain to 66 % DCM/33 % methanol; rock at room temperature for 6–8 h. Wear double nitrile gloves, work in a hood, and wipe exterior with ≥70 % ethanol.
Transfer to 100 % DCM; rock 1 h, wipe exterior with ≥70 % ethanol.
Transfer to fresh 100 % DCM; rock 1 h.
Transfer to 100 % DBE; incubate 3–24 h at room temperature without rocking, inverting the sample several times.
Wipe the vial exterior with ≥70 % ethanol.
Store brains indefinitely at room temperature or 4 °C (dark, minimal air).

steps.title: Prepare microscope and mounting
steps.instruction: Set up the light‑sheet microscope, add the appropriate refractive‑index solution, and affix the cleared brain to the holder.

substeps.instruction: Install appropriate filters (e.g., 488 nm excitation, 525 nm emission for autofluorescence).
Align light‑sheets per manufacturer’s guide.
Wear gloves; avoid plastic items unless verified compatible with solvents.
Add BABB‑D15 (uDISCO) or DBE (iDISCO) to the microscope chamber as instructed by the instrument manufacturer.
Clean the custom 3D‑printed brain holder with ethanol and let dry.
Place the cleared brain on a paper towel, apply a minimal amount of super glue to the brainstem or olfactory bulbs, and attach to the holder.
Insert the holder into the imaging chamber filled with the matching clearing solution.

steps.title: Acquire light‑sheet images
steps.instruction: Collect tiled image stacks with sufficient overlap and proper orientation, then return the brain to storage.

substeps.instruction: Turn on lasers, camera, motorized stage, and acquisition software.
Acquire tiles with ≥20 % overlap; orient the brain so the smallest axis is parallel to the detection objective and perpendicular to the light‑sheets.
After acquisition, place the brain back into its storage solution (BABB‑D15 or DBE).
Power off all equipment and clean the microscope thoroughly.

steps.title: Process imaging data
steps.instruction: Run the provided registration scripts on a compute cluster with the appropriate folder arguments.

substeps.instruction: Execute spim_downsize_n_register.sh providing: path to main image folder, registration channel subfolder name, and cell‑channel subfolder name (repeat registration name if only one channel).
If needed, run sub_registration.sh for additional processing.

description: Validation of protocol In addition to the eight animals used to create the PRA, we discarded two brains due to damage or streaking in the imaging, and six additional successfully cleared brains were used for supplementary figures and further internal validation on various sizes of brains.
